content_zh:
他的目的是干掉三个操纵者，阻止故事最开始设定的结局发生，这就足够了，将所有事件的影响力控制在骑士们意气用事的程度上即可。
邢烨对着加西亚公爵的背影单膝跪地，沉声道：“公爵大人，是我的固执为您带来了麻烦。十分感谢您的关怀，可是骑士之间的事，就要用剑来解决。”
说罢他对侍卫长说：“我要与你决斗，如果我输了，骑士团将接受侍卫队搜身，与女王陛下和公爵大人无关。但若我要是赢了，你需要以个人名义向骑士团道歉，并允许公爵大人派人搜我们的身。身为骑士，我们只接受主人的质疑。”
这番话说得十分得体，前来看热闹的贵族纷纷点头，这才是骑士应有的精神。
侍卫长却快气死了，何以决斗，何以又决斗？你们骑士难道一言不合就拔剑吗？
“发生了什么事？”一个慵懒优雅的女声传来。
骑士之间的骚动终于引来了女王，她穿着华贵的衣服，头戴面纱，手掌搭在一名英俊的男子肩上，身后跟着几个相貌平平的女仆。
邢烨立刻改向女王跪下，抢在侍卫长前面请罪：“女王陛下，很抱歉，是我的浅薄无知惊扰到了您。可是身为一名骑士，总要有些坚持不能放弃，请女王陛下允许我与侍卫长决斗，以守护我的尊严。”
先把处事不当得罪贵族骑士团的帽子给侍卫长扣下去，再要求公开决斗，按照这个时代的习俗，是不会有人拒绝的。
女王果然没有生气，反而笑道：“骑士们总是如此冲动，这就是年轻的好处啊。好吧，骑士们之间的矛盾，就用决斗来解决吧。”
其实所谓骑士在贵族们眼中不过是地位高一点的下人罢了，每年节庆之日，骑士们之间的生死决斗还是贵族们的消遣节目呢。就算邢烨没有搞出这件事来，女王可能也会找两名身手好的骑士决斗助兴，现在是正中下怀。
原本皇族侍卫长身手应该是一流的，可是眼前这位，呵呵……
邢烨与侍卫长被带到官方决斗的位置，贵族们坐在看台上，女仆将剑交给两人，加西亚公爵坐在位子上，眉头紧皱，低声自语：“她怎么如此倔强，我完全可以帮助她的，她却不给我添麻烦，偏偏要用这种方式解决，可她毕竟只是一个……”
在众人的视线之下，侍卫长与邢烨靠近握手拥抱，以表示不管决斗结果如何，双方都是好朋友，不会记恨对方。
侍卫长趁着这个机会，在邢烨耳边低声道：“你疯了吗？究竟想做什么？”
邢烨微微一笑：“引出第三个人而已。”
说罢快速推开，手掌握住剑柄，身体肌肉紧绷，整个人像一只进入狩猎状态的猎豹。
侍卫长也握住剑，心想干脆打两招就认输吧，搜身的时候以后再想办法。
决斗开始号角响起的瞬间，邢烨一个箭步冲到侍卫长面前，他速度太多，动作太过果决，让侍卫长根本没有反抗的机会。
侍卫长甚至连剑都未拔出，就见邢烨出现在自己面前，紧接着脖子一凉，鲜血溅出。

倒下时侍卫长只模模糊糊地看到邢烨用胸前的手绢将剑上的鲜血擦干，便死不瞑目地闭上眼。
他怎么会，他又怎么敢？竟然在女王的生日上杀掉皇族侍卫长，这个逆命阵营的执行者究竟是怎么想的？
他本以为，这场决斗最多只是被揍一顿，输掉决斗后无法搜身，可为什么会是这样的结局？侍卫长到死都不明白，邢烨究竟有什么打算，竟然做出这么惊人的事情。
邢烨将剑放入剑鞘中，扫了眼侍卫长无法置信的脸，心下了然。
这位操纵者无论如何都想不到吧，属于自己的结局竟然在是公开决斗时死在加西亚公爵的骑士剑下。
干掉一名操纵者后，邢烨先是仰头观察观众席每个人的表情，紧接着在一片哗然中向着加西亚公爵跪地，大声道：“公爵阁下，是我失手了。我只当皇族侍卫长剑术高明，便一开始就出了全力。却没想到……
不管怎样，我都犯下了杀人的罪行，请公爵阁下处死我。”
有两个人将邢烨从决斗场带到女王与公爵面前，女王身后的英俊男子脸色扭曲，手指发抖。

content_en:
His purpose is to kill the three manipulators and prevent the ending set at the beginning of the story from happening. This is enough, and the impact of all events can be controlled to the extent that the knights are motivated.
Xing Ye knelt down on one knee facing Duke Garcia's back and said in a deep voice: "Your Majesty, it is my stubbornness that has brought you trouble. Thank you very much for your concern, but matters between knights must be resolved with swords."
After that, he said to the captain of the guard: "I want to duel with you. If I lose, the knights will be searched by the guards. It has nothing to do with Her Majesty the Queen and the Duke. But if I win, you need to apologize to the knights personally and allow the Duke to send people to search us. As knights, we only accept the master's doubts."
These words were very appropriate, and the nobles who came to watch the excitement nodded. This is the spirit that a knight should have.
But the captain of the guard was almost furious. Why should we duel? Why should we duel again? Do you knights draw their swords at the slightest disagreement?
"What happened?" came a lazy and elegant female voice.
The commotion among the knights finally attracted the queen. She was dressed in luxurious clothes and veil, with her palms on the shoulders of a handsome man, followed by several ordinary-looking maids.
Xing Ye immediately knelt down to the queen and apologized before the captain of the guard: "Your Majesty the Queen, I'm sorry that my ignorance has disturbed you. But as a knight, there is always some persistence that cannot be given up. Please allow me to duel with the captain of the guard to protect my dignity."
First, let the captain of the guard take off the hat for his inappropriate behavior and offend the noble knights, and then ask for a public duel. According to the customs of this era, no one will refuse.
The queen was not angry as expected, but smiled and said: "Knights are always so impulsive. This is the benefit of being young. Well, let's resolve the conflicts between knights with a duel."
In fact, in the eyes of the nobles, the so-called knights are just servants with a higher status. On every festival day, the life-and-death duels between knights are still a pastime for the nobles. Even if Xing Ye hadn't caused this incident, the queen might have found two skilled knights to duel for fun, which is exactly what she wanted now.
Originally, the captain of the royal guard should be top-notch, but this one in front of me, haha...
Xing Ye and the captain of the guard were brought to the official duel location. The nobles sat in the stands, and the maid handed the sword to the two of them. Duke Garcia sat on the seat, frowning, and whispered to himself: "Why is she so stubborn? I can definitely help her, but she doesn't cause me any trouble. She has to solve it in this way. But after all, she is just one..."
Under the eyes of everyone, the captain of the guard and Xing Ye came close to shake hands and hugged each other to show that no matter what the outcome of the duel was, both parties were good friends and would not hold grudges against each other.
The captain of the guard took this opportunity and whispered in Xing Ye's ear: "Are you crazy? What do you want to do?"
Xing Ye smiled slightly: "It's just to attract the third person."
After saying that, he quickly pushed away, holding the hilt of the sword with his palm, his body muscles tensed, and his whole body looked like a cheetah in hunting mode.
The captain of the guard also held the sword, thinking that he might as well admit defeat after just two moves, and he would think of a solution later during the body search.
The moment the horn sounded to start the duel, Xing Ye rushed in front of the captain of the guard. He was too fast and his movements were too decisive, leaving the captain of the guard no chance to resist.
The captain of the guard didn't even pull out his sword when he saw Xing Ye appear in front of him. Then his neck felt cold and blood splattered out.
When he fell down, the captain of the guard could only vaguely see Xing Ye wiping the blood on his sword with the handkerchief on his chest, and then he closed his eyes in silence.
How could he, how dare he? He actually killed the royal guard chief on the queen's birthday. What on earth was this executor of the fate-defying camp thinking?
He originally thought that the most he would get in this duel was a beating, and he would not be able to search himself after losing the duel, but forHow could this end? The captain of the guard did not understand until his death what Xing Ye's plan was to do such an amazing thing.
Xing Ye put the sword into the scabbard, glanced at the unbelievable face of the captain of the guard, and became convinced.
This manipulator never imagined that his end would be to die under Duke Garcia's knight's sword in a public duel.
After killing a manipulator, Xing Ye first looked up and observed the expressions of everyone in the audience, and then knelt down to Duke Garcia in the uproar and said loudly: "Your Majesty the Duke, I made a mistake. I only thought that the royal guard was good at swordsmanship, so I used my full strength from the beginning. But I didn't expect...
No matter what, I have committed the crime of murder. Please, Your Excellency, put me to death. "
Two people brought Xing Ye from the duel arena to the queen and the duke. The handsome man behind the queen had a twisted face and trembling fingers.
